observations: The target initialization aligns CA1Fh to CA20h and copies 1346h bytes to the DOS data segment.
Under the independently inferred DOSCODE file base, the aligned source points exactly to the previously identified target DOSDATA file base.
In the historical source and map, the copied MSDAT001E offset, DOSDATA segment length and DOSDATASIZ are all 136Ah.
The corresponding target DOSDATASIZ is therefore strongly supported as 1346h if the same size convention is retained.
Historical GETSIZE reads the DOSDATA, BIOS_DATA and BIOS_CODE segment lengths from the linker maps and writes them as the three BDSIZE equates.
limitations: The target literal proves copy length, but the relationship to a separately authored target BDSIZE.INC remains an inference from the historical build convention.
The BIOS size pair and final source/link layout remain unresolved.
No core source constants are changed by this report.
The target BIOS segment lengths cannot be recovered from the aggregate alone; they must come from independently established target segment boundaries or a reconstructed target map.
conditional_bios_sum_warning: The legacy formula and interpretation of the target BIOS resource boundary are in conditional tension; see origin-bios-size-assumption-conflict.json. Do not use the aggregate as a proven target size.
